_doc: Personality (Update 03 section 8): a weight profile for one character's bot (and Jakub). actions: multipliers on the action scores (actions.json). role_bias: how much it wants each squad role. aim.class_pref: weapon class multipliers for weapon choice (and the wall guns it wants). aim.head_bias: added to the headshot preference. aim.specials_first: extra target priority for specials and bosses. combat: retreat_hp (the HP fraction it starts thinking about retreating, multiplies the retreat input), melee_crawlers (knifes crawlers), grenade_bias (more / fewer grenades), keep_distance_m (preferred fighting distance), ammo_conserve (shorter bursts), aggression (pushes the fight score). economy: save_bias (multiplies the Scrip it keeps in reserve), perk_order (its perk plan; empty = economy.json default), perk_skill (better perk picks). callouts: boss_first (calls bosses and specials before anyone), kill_tally (keeps a running tally in her lines), grumble_on_move (grumbles when ordered to move), comments_by (a second voice comments on its decisions). chatter: lines between rounds.
_summary: Careful. Conserves ammo, prefers bolt-actions, always covers the player who freed him, never runs ahead. Under fire he stays steady. T-177 (the owner: the companions use the bank, buy perks, the Crucible and weapon upgrades): between rounds he spends the Scrip his own kills earned on tonics, a wall gun, the Crucible, the Armorer's Bench and his own savings; T-245 (the owner: companions get perks and wonder weapons): the Requisition Crate too (crate 0.8, in a break, from its own Scrip, like a squad bot), and a tonic mid-round when it is calm and the machine is near the one it follows.
